chapter: Pianists, radio and cafes of old New Orleans
title: Tom Zimmerman, Kid Ross, Henry Regas, Buzzy Williams and old comedians
summary: Leclerc recalls Tom Zimmerman at Anderson's, Henry Regas, Chittenden, Paul Serpass and Buzzy Williams, mostly playing after World War I.
